Investor Opportunity: 99 Gallatin Ave, Buffalo, NY 14207 (Black Rock-Riverside Neighborhood)Affordable 3-Bed Starter Rental with Ultra-Low Carrying Costs. This compact 3-bedroom, 1-bath, 1,160 sq ft single-family home (built 1900) sits on a 3,000 sq ft lot in the established Black Rock-Riverside area — a working-class neighborhood with steady rental demand from local families, proximity to the Niagara River, parks, transit, and employment anchors. 


Key Investment Highlights:Strong Value Entry: Current estimates range ~$119K–$171K (Zestimate ~$119K–$126K recently; Redfin ~$171K), offering solid entry pricing in a market where median Black Rock sales hover around $161K. 


Rental Upside: Rent Zestimate ~$1,519–$1,517/mo. Neighborhood median rents ~$1,300+, with demand for 3-bed single-family homes supporting attractive cash flow in Buffalo’s favorable price-to-rent environment. (Current rent $1400)

Basic Specs & Potential: Full basement, aluminum/vinyl exterior, oil hot air heat. Older construction means opportunity for light cosmetic updates, mechanical refreshes, or minor rehab to push rents and value higher. Fenced lot supports tenant appeal. 


Market Tailwinds: Black Rock-Riverside remains a resilient pocket in Buffalo’s 2026 investment landscape — known for affordability, rental stability, and gradual revitalization. Buffalo continues ranking high for cash-flow investors seeking Rust Belt yields without premium pricing. 

Perfect for:Buy-and-hold cash-flow rental
House hacking or starter investor property
Light value-add flip or long-term hold in a high-yield zip code
